title: Code: Data trimming to remove outliers

cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to illustrate the data trimming method to you in MATLAB and then in Python.
cues.zh: 講師：現在會先用 MATLAB，再用 Python，示範資料修剪方法。

cues.en: So let's start by creating some data.
cues.zh: 先建立一些資料。

cues.en: I'm going to create just some random numbers, normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 只產生一些常態分布隨機數。

cues.en: And then what I do is basically manipulate the dataset a little bit here in order to increase the likelihood of having some outliers, both positive outliers and negative outliers.
cues.zh: 接著稍微修改資料集，增加出現離群值的機率，包括正值和負值的離群值。

cues.en: And I'm doing this in a way that I've shown you before, a couple videos ago, but essentially I'm just saying, any data points that are greater than two
cues.zh: 方法和幾部影片前展示的一樣，基本上就是任何大於 2 的資料點，

cues.en: become themselves squared.
cues.zh: 都換成自身的平方。

cues.en: Likewise, any data points that are less than negative two become those data points squared.
cues.zh: 同樣地，任何小於 −2 的資料點，也換成自身的平方。

cues.en: And then, I have to add the minus sign again, so we can get some negative outliers.
cues.zh: 接著必須再加上負號，才能得到負值離群值。

cues.en: And then here, I'm mean-centering the data.
cues.zh: 這裡再將資料平均中心化。

cues.en: Now, the thing is, of course, in theory, these are normally distributed data, so we would expect the mean to be exactly zero, that's the sort of population mean,
cues.zh: 當然，理論上這些是常態分布資料，所以預期平均值恰好為 0，這算是母體平均值，

cues.en: or the theoretical mean of this distribution should be zero.
cues.zh: 或者說，這個分布的理論平均值應該為 0。

cues.en: But because we are sampling from this distribution, it's pretty unlikely that we are going to get exactly zero.
cues.zh: 但因為我們是從分布中抽樣，所以不太可能恰好得到 0。

cues.en: I'm gonna talk more about why that is the case in the next section about probability theory.
cues.zh: 下一章談機率理論時，會進一步說明原因。

cues.en: Okay, so in this particular case, the way I happen to simulate these data, it's debatable whether I need to explicitly mean-center, but I'm doing it anyway
cues.zh: 在這個特定情況，根據模擬方式，是否需要明確做平均中心化可以討論，但我還是會做，

cues.en: just so we have the full technique here.
cues.zh: 只是為了完整呈現這項技術。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm plotting them referring to data because there's, you know, data is plural, datum would be it, so I'm plotting those data.
cues.zh: 接著把它們畫出來，我說「它們」是指資料，因為 data 是複數，單數是 datum，所以是畫出那些資料。

cues.en: Here we go, here's what these data look like.
cues.zh: 這就是這組資料的樣子。

cues.en: And this looks pretty cool, so we get one outlier on the positive side and one outlier on the negative side.
cues.zh: 這看起來很棒，正值側有一個離群值，負值側也有一個。

cues.en: And then all the other data points are fitting nicely into the kind of center clustering of this distribution.
cues.zh: 其他資料點都很好地集中在分布中央。

cues.en: So that works out pretty well for our illustration.
cues.zh: 很適合拿來示範。

cues.en: Let's see, this figure we don't really need, that's just to show you basically just to recreate the figures I had in the slide.
cues.zh: 這張圖其實不太需要，只是用來重現投影片中的圖形。

cues.en: So you can look through this if you want, but I'm just going to move forward.
cues.zh: 有興趣可以看看，但我直接繼續。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm gonna show you the two options.
cues.zh: 現在示範兩個選項。

cues.en: The first one is...
cues.zh: 第一個是……

cues.en: Actually the second one that I listed in the slide, so here I'm going to remove the top k-th percent of the data.
cues.zh: 其實是投影片列出的第二個，這裡要移除資料中最極端的 k%。

cues.en: And in this case, I'm picking five just because five is a nice round number.
cues.zh: 這裡選 5，只是因為 5 是個漂亮的整數。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is identify the fifth percentile from the top, which is, actually the way that this gets implemented is as 100 minus this percent.
cues.zh: 要辨識由頂端算起的 5% 分位位置，實作方式其實是 100 減去這個百分比。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is identifying the 95th percentile, and then I'm gonna say that any data values beyond the 95th percentile are removed from the data.
cues.zh: 所以這裡找出第 95 百分位數，再把超過第 95 百分位數的資料值移除。

cues.en: So that's just a little bit inverted, but that's just the way that I'm implementing it here.
cues.zh: 有一點反過來，但這裡就是這樣實作。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see.
cues.zh: 好，看看。

cues.en: So the data cutoff in this particular dataset ends up being 3.28, so that means any data value...
cues.zh: 這組特定資料的切點最後是 3.28，也就是任何資料值……

cues.en: And remember, we're always working with the absolute value here, so we include both the negative and the positive outliers.
cues.zh: 記住，這裡一直使用絕對值，所以正、負離群值都包含在內。

cues.en: So any data value that is greater than 3.28, either positive or negative, those get removed from the data.
cues.zh: 因此，不管正負，絕對值大於 3.28 的資料都會移除。

cues.en: So that's gonna be these two guys here.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡這兩個。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm gonna go back and cross these out from the first figure.
cues.zh: 接著回到第一張圖，用叉號標掉。

cues.en: So actually this worked out really well, this turned out to be a really nice method for this particular dataset and this particular threshold.
cues.zh: 這次效果確實很好，對這個特定資料集和門檻而言，是很好的方法。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's look at the compliment of this one, which is to remove the k most extreme values.
cues.zh: 現在看看另一種對應做法，也就是移除最極端的 k 個值。

cues.en: Again, this is on both sides.
cues.zh: 同樣地，兩側都考慮。

cues.en: So now I'm just specifying k to be three, it's an arbitrary and somewhat subjective choice, but that's what the code says we're gonna do in this case.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 k=3，選擇有點任意、也有點主觀，但這次程式就是設定這樣做。

cues.en: So we are going to remove the k most extreme values, so I'm sorting them, and again, I'm sorting the absolute value of them,
cues.zh: 要移除最極端的 k 個值，所以先排序，而且同樣是對絕對值排序，

cues.en: so that we pull together the positive and the negative signs, basically we are ignoring the negative signs.
cues.zh: 把正負兩側合在一起，基本上就是忽略負號。

cues.en: So then I'm taking the first k-th elements in this sorted index, and those are gonna get removed.
cues.zh: 接著取排序後索引的前 k 個元素，將它們移除。

cues.en: So then I put a green circle around those guys.
cues.zh: 再用綠色圓圈圈起來。

cues.en: So here, you see this kind of nicely illustrates one of the limitations that I discussed in the slides a moment ago.
cues.zh: 這裡很好地呈現了剛才投影片討論的一個限制。

cues.en: So when we do this based on the thresholding 95%, that worked pretty well for this particular dataset.
cues.zh: 根據 95% 門檻處理時，對這組資料效果很好。

cues.en: But when I set k to be hard coded to be three, we actually ended up removing this data point.
cues.zh: 但把 k 固定設為 3，就連這個資料點也被移除了。

cues.en: And I really don't think that we should be removing this data point, it doesn't look like there's an outlier here.
cues.zh: 我真的不覺得應該移除這個點，它看起來不是離群值。

cues.en: Now, when you look at this result, you might be tempted to say, well, okay, you know this, a hard coding of k to be a specific number is bad, and this is great,
cues.zh: 看到這個結果，你可能會想，好，把 k 寫死成特定數字不好，而這個方法很棒，

cues.en: so I'm just always going to blindly use 5%.
cues.zh: 所以以後都不加思考地使用 5%。

cues.en: But I encourage you to go back and rerun this code multiple times, get different datasets, and you'll see that this method also does not always produce a really great result.
cues.zh: 但我鼓勵你回去多執行幾次程式，取得不同資料集，就會看到這個方法也不是總能產生很好的結果。

cues.en: All right, so I am going to simulate some normally distributed or Gaussian distributed data.
cues.zh: 好，現在模擬一些常態分布，也就是高斯分布的資料。

cues.en: So these are going to have an expected mean of zero, and an expected variance of one.
cues.zh: 它們預期的平均值為 0，預期的變異數為 1。

cues.en: And then I'm just adding a little bit of code to increase the probability of finding outliers in this dataset.
cues.zh: 接著加上一點程式，提高在資料集中找到離群值的機率。

cues.en: So I say that any data points that happen to be greater than two become themselves squared.
cues.zh: 任何剛好大於 2 的資料點，都換成自身平方。

cues.en: And also any data points that happen to be less than minus two become themselves squared, and then of course, you have to explicitly add this minus sign here
cues.zh: 任何剛好小於 −2 的資料點，也換成自身平方，然後當然必須明確加上這個負號，

cues.en: because the squaring will get rid of the negative sign.
cues.zh: 因為平方會消掉負號。

cues.en: So again, these two lines of code just increase the probability of getting outliers on the negative side, so the left side of the distribution, and also on the right side of the distribution.
cues.zh: 再次說明，這兩行程式只是增加在負值側，也就是分布左側，以及分布右側出現離群值的機率。

cues.en: So here I compute the mean-centered data.
cues.zh: 這裡計算平均中心化資料。

cues.en: Now, you might argue that in this particular case, I do not need this line of code, and that's because we expect the average of this dataset to be zero.
cues.zh: 你可能認為，在這個特定情況不需要這行程式，因為預期這組資料的平均值就是 0。

cues.en: That's kind of the definition, or Gaussian distributed random noise.
cues.zh: 這算是高斯分布隨機雜訊的定義。

cues.en: However, because of sampling variability, the mean is unlikely to be exactly zero.
cues.zh: 然而，由於抽樣變異，平均值不太可能恰好等於 0。

cues.en: And furthermore, I think it's just good to have this code in here because that's kind of the way you would want to set up this analysis for real anyway.
cues.zh: 此外，我也認為保留這段程式很好，因為實際上本來就應該這樣設定分析。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see.
cues.zh: 好，看看。

cues.en: And then we just plot these data.
cues.zh: 接著只要把資料畫出來。

cues.en: So here we go, this worked out pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 這次結果相當有趣。

cues.en: We get a pretty healthy clustered set of data here, and then there's one lonely little data point all the way out here,
cues.zh: 這裡有一群聚集得很正常的資料，然後遠處有一個孤單的小資料點，

cues.en: it looks to me like this is going to be an outlier.
cues.zh: 在我看來，它會是離群值。

cues.en: So now here I'm showing you the two options that I discussed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這裡展示前一部影片談到的兩個選項。

cues.en: I'm actually gonna start first by removing the k-th percentile of the data, which was kind of the second thing that I discussed in the slides, but whatever.
cues.zh: 我其實先從移除資料的 k 百分比開始，這是投影片中第二個討論的內容，不過無所謂。

cues.en: So I'm saying here to remove the fifth percentile, so the way this actually gets implemented, is I'm computing the, in fact, 95th percentile of the data,
cues.zh: 這裡說要移除 5%，實作方式其實是計算資料的第 95 百分位數，

cues.en: so it's a 100 minus whatever we set this parameter to be.
cues.zh: 也就是 100 減去這個參數設定的值。

cues.en: So I identify the 95th percentile in the data, and then I say that any data values that are greater than that cutoff,
cues.zh: 找出資料中的第 95 百分位數，再把任何大於這個切點的資料值，

cues.en: those are going to be identified as outliers.
cues.zh: 辨識為離群值。

cues.en: And again, I'm using abs here because what I care about is the extreme values in the data regardless of whether they're extreme positive or extreme negative.
cues.zh: 同樣地，使用 abs，是因為在意的是資料中的極端值，不管是極端正值還是極端負值。

cues.en: Okay, and then we're gonna mark that as a red x in the data.
cues.zh: 接著在資料中以紅色 X 標記。

cues.en: So this is pretty interesting, it certainly removed this point here.
cues.zh: 相當有趣，它確實移除了這個點。

cues.en: It suggested that we label this as an outlier, so I agree with that.
cues.zh: 建議把它標記為離群值，這點我同意。

cues.en: But this other point happened to be inside this fifth percentile, so outside the 95th percentile of the data range when it was sorted.
cues.zh: 但另一個點剛好也落在最極端的 5% 裡，也就是排序後超過資料範圍第 95 百分位數的位置。

cues.en: And I'm not so sure, you know, this is at the edge of the distribution, but I don't know if this is really considered to be an outlier.
cues.zh: 我不太確定，它是在分布邊緣，但不知道是否真的應該視為離群值。

cues.en: So maybe based on this distribution, we might want to go back and change this to, you know, we could change this to try 3%, or 2%, 4.168%.
cues.zh: 所以根據這個分布，也許可以回頭修改，試試 3%、2%，或 4.168%。

cues.en: You can see that, you know, every time in statistics you have to come up with some threshold, there's always going to be a little bit of subjectivity, a little bit of arbitrariness in that selection.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，在統計中每次需要設定門檻，選擇都難免帶有一點主觀性和任意性。

cues.en: Okay, so this is for removing k percent of the data.
cues.zh: 好，這是移除 k% 的資料。

cues.en: And here I'm gonna show you removing the k most extreme values.
cues.zh: 這裡則示範移除最極端的 k 個值。

cues.en: So here we also have to pick some threshold, which is again, a little bit arbitrary, a little bit subjective.
cues.zh: 同樣需要選一個門檻，再次帶有一點任意性和主觀性。

cues.en: I set this to be three, and then what I do is basically sort the data values, the absolute value of the mean-centered data.
cues.zh: 我設為 3，接著基本上就是對資料值排序，也就是平均中心化資料的絕對值。

cues.en: And then I just take the first three elements, so the first three elements of the data sorted indices.
cues.zh: 再取前三個元素，也就是資料排序索引的前三個元素。

cues.en: And I'm going to mark those as green circles in the plot.
cues.zh: 然後在圖中用綠色圓圈標記。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: So here's all the data in the yellow triangles, the red x's is from the percentile removal, it's exactly the same as in the previous graph.
cues.zh: 黃色三角形表示全部資料，紅色 X 是百分比移除的結果，和前一張圖完全相同。

cues.en: And then here in green, you see the three value threshold.
cues.zh: 綠色則表示三個數值的門檻。

cues.en: (chuckles) Apologies for this somewhat embarrassing typo here, I'll make sure I fix that before I upload the code.
cues.zh: 〔笑〕抱歉，這裡有個有點丟臉的錯字，上傳程式之前一定會修正。

cues.en: Let's see, that should be threshold, something like that.
cues.zh: 看看，這裡應該是 threshold，大概像這樣。

cues.en: And I'll maybe even plot this again, there.
cues.zh: 也許再畫一次，好了。

cues.en: Okay, so this k value threshold here turned out to be really, I think we can agree this is inappropriate here.
cues.zh: 這個 k 值門檻的結果，我想大家都同意，在這裡並不適當。

cues.en: This data point certainly should be removed, this data point is questionable, but probably shouldn't be removed.
cues.zh: 這個資料點確實應該移除，這個有爭議，但大概不該移除。

cues.en: And this data point also really doesn't look like it's an outlier, although it is kind of at the edge of the distribution.
cues.zh: 這個點看起來也真的不像離群值，雖然有點接近分布邊緣。

cues.en: But technically this fulfilled our criteria, you know, these are really the three most extreme values in this dataset.
cues.zh: 但技術上它符合我們的標準，確實是這組資料中最極端的三個值。

cues.en: So I think this graph, and I encourage you to run through this, and you know, play around with these parameter settings, with these k threshold value settings.
cues.zh: 所以這張圖，我鼓勵你親自執行，試著調整這些參數、這些 k 門檻設定。

cues.en: But I think this highlights the main limitation of data trimming that I discussed at the end of the previous video, which is that sometimes data trimming can work really well,
cues.zh: 我認為這凸顯了前一部影片最後討論的資料修剪主要限制：有時效果很好，

cues.en: and sometimes it's a little bit awkward, it can also remove additional data that you might not want to remove.
cues.zh: 有時卻有點尷尬，還可能移除你原本不想移除的額外資料。
